sources.title: mradermacher/InternVL3-78B-Instruct-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Usage If you are unsure how to use GGUF files, refer to one of TheBloke's READMEs for more details, including on how to concatenate multi-part files. Provided Quants (sorted by size, not necessarily quality. IQ-quants are often preferable over similar sized non-IQ quants)
